head: YouTube TV members can get 3 months of YouTube Premium free
dek: YouTube TV subscribers in the US who have never had YouTube Premium or a Premium trial can get three months of it at no cost, through a code sent by email.
details: It's for individual Premium plans, not family or student plans. After three months it renews at $15.99 a month unless you cancel. No end date was given for the offer, so the codes may expire.
where: US, YouTube TV subscribers new to Premium
means: If you pay for YouTube TV and never tried Premium, you can watch YouTube without ads for three months.
todo: Look for the email with your code and redeem it with the same Google account. Set a reminder before the three months end if you don't want to pay $15.99 a month after that.
